The '''X-37 Oppressor Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that served among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] forces on the [[Maelstrom Prison]]. It was destroyed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces that [[Battle of the Maelstrom|raided]] the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] early in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The X-37 Oppressor Droid appears as the first boss in the Flashpoint "Maelstrom Prison" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
